title: Canonicalization preserves edges
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices, and let $i,j$ be vertices. There is an edge from $i$ to $j$ in the canonical form of $C$ if and only if there is an edge from $i$ to $j$ in $C$.
hypotheses_covered: A directed acyclic Boolean circuit on $n$ input vertices
caveat: The provided formal snippet uses the circuit's canonical form but does not include its definition, so its meaning cannot be fully specified from the supplied material.
